verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard tracks costs, requests and tokens in real time across all models and providers in one place. Per-key monthly spend caps and service accounts, whose spend is explicitly not tied to a user, imply that spend is attributed to keys and users. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-key and per-user spend breakdowns in analytics, any evidence of team-level spend attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
